title_zh: 明确无障碍底线后询问场租报价

scenario.label_zh: 确定活动场租谈判的边界
scenario.goal_zh: 确认无障碍入口不可取消，约定以缩短时段换取报价而不作租用承诺

context_zh: 社区活动组织者米洛与黛比商量如何向场馆询问更合适的租用条件。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Could you negotiate a lower room price? The quote is beyond our budget.

sentences.speaker: Debbie
sentences.text: I can ask. Would a shorter booking give us a useful starting point for the negotiation?

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Yes, but we can't move upstairs. A step-free entrance is a necessity for several participants.

sentences.speaker: Debbie
sentences.text: Agreed. Saving money isn't a reason to exclude them.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: The manager sounded firm about the price. Nevertheless, asking about two hours instead of three seems reasonable.

sentences.speaker: Debbie
sentences.text: Email is the simplest means of getting a clear written answer. I'll explain the shorter session and the access requirement.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Please ask for a revised quote, not a confirmed booking. We still need to check the total.

sentences.speaker: Debbie
sentences.text: Understood. I'll bring the reply back to you before we make any commitment.

targets.sense_zh: 必不可少的事物或条件
